title: Revolutionizing Database Internals Monitoring with eBPF and Real-Time Insights
summary: Discover how Odigos revolutionizes database monitoring with eBPF technology. Gain real-time insights into MySQL and PostgreSQL performance by connecting client and server activities in a single trace. Optimize queries, troubleshoot issues, and enhance database efficiency with minimal overhead. Experience the future of observability with Odigos`s innovative eBPF-powered monitoring solution.
